o: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the sixteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

eps.o: The queens toast to a new season and discuss Xunami Muse's catchy song, Mirage's fabulous dance moves and O's stunning costume, and guest judge Charlize Theron joins for a heart-to-heart.
The queens unwind and discuss Mhi'ya Iman LePaige's showstopping flips, Nymphia Wind's gag-worthy ruveal, and Megami's solemn performance, and Becky G drops in with encouraging words.
The lounge gets tense as the queens offer each other brutally honest and unsolicited critiques, and the first to be eliminated proudly stands by her runway looks.
RDR Live! served up plenty of jokes, but it's no laughing matter when an ongoing conflict resurfaces, and Sarah Michelle Gellar crashes the party and slays the queens.
After a gag-worthy performance, the winning girl group revels in their victory, Q hits a nerve when she critiques Xunami Muse, and Icona Pop drops in for a visit.
The queens discover that some amongst them are shadier than others following the week's design challenge, and fashion icon Law Roach drops in with some critiques.
After performing in a rusical, tensions are high as the queens compare choreography and debate who had the most steps in the Swish Alps, and Adam Shankman drops in for a kiki.
Fallout from Snatch Game is anything but a laughing matter as the queens discuss who scored and who flopped, and Kyra Sedgwick stops by to remind everyone that attitude is everything.
After the spooky design challenge, the queens are coming apart at the seams, and runway model Kaia Gerber sashays in for a fashionable kiki.
Things get funky in the Untucked Lounge when the queens ponder the power of their Werq the World performances, and Jamal Sims struts in to break it down for them.
After their critiques, the queens settle in and have a kiki with Joel Kim Booster about the magic of drag, and a video from home has everyone feeling their emotions.
After the queens design and showcase bathrooms, Plane Jane gets vulnerable, the girls talk teamwork, and Mayan Lopez pops by with some much needed relief.
After their critiques on the makeovers of dancers from RuPaul's Drag Race LIVE! in Las Vegas, the queens praise Kelsea Ballerini for being a strong ally.
After their critiques, the queens reflect on the last challenge ahead of the finals, and Ts Madison stops by to offer words of encouragement.
